title: Tiled VAE decode for MiniMax H3 reference-to-video - 2K and 4K OOM on a 32GB card
description: REJECTED - premise wrong. The H3 video VAE already tiles internally (comfy/sd.py:957 handles_tiling=True) and plain VAEDecode already falls back to tiled decoding on OOM (sd.py:1190-1213), so the VAE Decode node already in the graph IS the tiled path and a tiled node buys zero VRAM. It also cannot be wired: an H3 LATENT is a NestedTensor (video, audio) and neither LTXVTiledVAEDecode nor core VAEDecodeTiled unbinds it, so both error. The real reading of the 32GB OOM is that decode tiled and still did not fit. Superseded by MPI-551, which labels every H3 2K/4K tier "Experimental - High VRAM"; 864x480 plus upscale stays the working route.
